title: Marrow Health color token pairs
brief: I'm the design systems engineer at Marrow Health and I need a color token page for the engineers who are building dark mode, to be read on laptops at their desks, dated 2026-11-02. Under "Token pairs" give a table of eight tokens with the light value, dark value and what it is for: background, #FFFFFF, #101418, page; surface, #F3F5F7, #1A2027, cards and panels; text, #14181C, #E8ECEF, body copy; text-muted, #5B6670, #9AA6B2, secondary copy; primary, #2F6FED, #6C9BFF, buttons and links; success, #1F9254, #4CC38A, confirmations; warning, #B26A00, #FFB454, cautions; danger, #C62828, #FF7A7A, errors. Show each value as a swatch beside its hex. Under "In use" show two copies of the same small appointment card, one in light values and one in dark, side by side: heading Dr. Okoro, follow-up, text Tuesday 10:30, a primary button reading Confirm, and a warning line reading Bring your insurance card, using the tokens above. Under "Rules" a list: text-muted on surface must keep at least 4.5 to 1 contrast in both modes; use danger only for errors, never decoration; and each new token needs a light and a dark value before it ships. Highlight the first rule as a warning.

edit.request: Change the dark value of primary to #7AA8FF, and add a ninth token called info with light value #0E7490 and dark value #5CC8E0 for neutral notices.
